title: “Arborlogues” is running at the Cell in NYC, through Sep 1st, produce...
transcript: would you pay $15 to spend 15 minutes talking to a tree? that's the question surrounding the return engagement of this very unusual theatrical experience called Arborlogues this is a solo experience so only one audience member per time slot and you're essentially guided to a tree in a backyard surrounded by a curtain you're given the script for an original monologue written specifically for this piece and you deliver it to the tree the tree is your audience and you are the performer and it's easy to joke about this silly premise but the reality is that the creators of the show are very much in on the joke themselves the stage manager who preps you is essentially a performer in the piece establishing and then committing to this delightfully quirky bit but underneath the absurdity there is a deeper layer to it the contents of the script encourage you to not only participate in this fun act of imagination but also to reflect on our relationship to the environment and this performance art concept of us performing for the benefit of a tree silly as it is is very much a deliberate subversion of how we normally relate to nature by the way Joey Sims wrote a really lovely article about it in the Times where he talks to the artist but also to audience members which really illuminates the kind of responses that this piece can elicit when you engage with it on its terms is it really worth $15 though? I will say I'm definitely glad I did it if nothing else at least it makes for a fun story although it did resonate with me on that deeper level I do wish it had been a little bit longer though not necessarily to get “more for my money” but because for a piece about taking a moment to reflect it did go by very quickly for me I wish I had more time to settle into the unusual experience before it was basically over but it also probably depends on your head space going into it
classificationReason: Creator attended and reviewed 'Arborlogues' at the Cell in NYC — a solo immersive theatrical experience not present anywhere on the approved show list.
